SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, COUNT(*) cnt1, cd_purchase_estimate, COUNT(*) cnt2, cd_credit_rating, COUNT(*) cnt3 
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_ship_customer_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk OR ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk OR cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE ca_state IN ('IL', 'TX', 'ME')
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
